status.summary: Former UFC welterweight champion (beat Tyron Woodley at UFC 235 in Mar 2019, five defenses, lost the belt to Leon Edwards by R5 head-kick KO in Aug 2022). Age 39. After beating Joaquin Buckley (UD, Jun 14, 2025) he moved up and lost a unanimous decision to Dricus Du Plessis (50-45, 49-46, 49-46) at middleweight in the UFC Fight Night 281 main event, Oklahoma City, Jul 18, 2026 (Fight of the Night). Pro record 21-5 (ESPN, Wikipedia); UFC 16-4; 1-4 in his last five; 0-2 at middleweight. He still holds a welterweight ranking: #9 (tied with Mike Malott) on the media panel and #11 in the Meta UFC Rankings; he is not ranked at middleweight. After the loss he said on his podcast he had to sit with his team and decide whether to continue (ESPN, Jul 24, 2026); his co-host Henry Cejudo said he fought with a torn pec, and Usman said an early eye injury left him seeing double. His manager Ali Abdelaziz said on Aug 6 that he is not retiring and should return to welterweight. A Sep 29, 2026 Bloody Elbow headline says he is open to a fight with YouTuber KSI 'amid uncertainty over return' (page returned 403). No fight is booked and no retirement has been announced (one low-quality site claiming a July retirement is contradicted by the manager and ESPN).
status.ranking: #9 welterweight, tied with Mike Malott (UFC media panel, Nov 3-5, 2026); #11 welterweight in the Meta UFC Rankings (Oct 31, 2026; Wikipedia also cites #11 as of Oct 17). Not in the middleweight top 15. Read from ufcrankings.org and ufcalendar.com mirrors because ufc.com returned 403.

injuries.what: Torn pectoral muscle going into the Du Plessis fight, per co-host Henry Cejudo on their Pound 4 Pound podcast; Usman declined to use it as an excuse. Side and treatment not reported.
Eye injury early in the Du Plessis fight (he called it a thumb-punch) that he said left him seeing double for the rest of the bout.

signature: body attack: 20% of sig attempts go to the body (middleweight and welterweight average about 14%); 41 of 50 body strikes vs Colby Covington (UFC 268), 37 of 58 vs Du Plessis (Jul 2026)
fence and top control: 10:36 of control vs Leon Edwards (UFC 278) and 12:57 vs Joaquin Buckley (Jun 2025); 40% control share career
punching power at distance: KO of Jorge Masvidal at 1:02 of R2 (UFC 261; ufcstats 'Punch to Head At Distance'), TKO of Covington in R5 (UFC 245), two knockdowns of Covington at UFC 268
takedown defense: 90% career; Covington went 0 for 11 at UFC 268 and Du Plessis 0 for 2
five-round pressure: 12 UFC five-round fights, output in R2-R5 runs 1.21-1.49x R1
weaknesses: takedowns no longer land: 27.6% accuracy decayed vs 42% career; 4 of 13 vs Buckley and 0 of 7 vs Du Plessis
smaller at 185: 18 of 20 UFC fights at welterweight, 0-2 at middleweight (Chimaev MD 2023, Du Plessis UD 2026)
leg kicks and kicks in general: Edwards landed 50 of 53 leg strikes at UFC 286 and finished him with a head kick at 4:04 of R5 at UFC 278
age 39 (born May 11, 1987) and only three fights since Mar 2023
style.summary: A strong wrestle-boxer who wore welterweights down with pressure, body punching, fence work and long spells on top, and who has the punching power to finish. Lately the takedowns have stopped landing (4 of 20 across his last two fights), which leaves him boxing bigger or longer men on even terms. He lost that kind of fight to Du Plessis at middleweight in Jul 2026.

moves.notes: Group shares follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 77.1% head, 19.9% body, 3.0% leg (career 76.3/19.2/4.5). League welterweight is 77.1/13.7/9.3 and middleweight 77.2/14.0/8.8, so he sends about 1.4x the league share to the body and a third of it to the legs. 74% of his landed sig is at distance decayed (60% career), with 16% in the clinch and 24% on the ground career; the knee weight of 0.12 reflects that clinch share. In the head group the jab and cross lead because his finishes are punches at distance (Masvidal KO, Covington TKO). His jab is widely praised in pre-2026 coverage, but no source was opened in this pass to confirm that. In the body group the straight leads as a judgment; ufcstats does not split body punches from kicks. Leg weights are small and judged. Spinning is 0. Stance is set to switch because ufcstats lists him as Switch.

engine_notes.note: Takedown accuracy has collapsed: 27.6% decayed vs 42.0% career, and decayed control share is 25.8% vs 40.5% career. A wrestling knob should use the decayed rate, not the title-era rate.
Only one knockdown absorbed in 20 UFC fights (the Edwards head kick, R5, Aug 2022); one KO/TKO loss.
Five-round pace across 12 fights: R2-R5 output is 1.49, 1.25, 1.41 and 1.21 times R1, above the welterweight curve of 1.27, 1.15, 1.16 and 1.08.
Late-round output slipped in his 2025 fight: Buckley out-landed him 20-10 in R5 while Usman went 0 for 6 on takedowns in that round.
